partition: Design / scope / taste of all 12 PRs; focus Bambu #6-#10 and #3 complexity

findings.title: Split the Project PR into its two independent fixes
findings.evidence: 0826d59e: resources/web/model_new/index.js (+40/-3, lines 1-51) is a self-contained page-side handshake fix (buffer early show/clear messages, retry request_3mf_info until window.wx.postMessage exists). It only uses the existing request_3mf_info / show_3mf_info protocol, which base 79df7ae3 Project.cpp already answers by replaying m_last_payload. The other 412 changed lines (Project.cpp/.hpp, Model.cpp/.hpp) change native publish order and worker lifetime. Body sentence 1 already names two separate triggers ('can wait for an optional network lookup OR miss the page's initial bridge request').
findings.trigger: Upstream reviewer opens #3 (455 changed lines, JS + C++ threading + libslic3r accessor) to review either bug.
findings.outcome: Two unrelated fixes in two languages must be reviewed and accepted together; a reviewer comfortable with the 43-line JS change cannot land it without signing off on the threading rewrite.
findings.smallest_fix: Two PRs on master: (3a) 'Retry the Project page's startup request' = index.js only (squash a66751278's JS part + 0826d59e1), ~43 lines; (3b) 'Show local Project information before the online model lookup' = Project.cpp/.hpp + Model accessor, ~412 lines. Fallback if the user prefers fewer PRs: keep one PR but as two commits in that order.
findings.verification: Apply each to 79df7ae3 independently; build 3b; run the existing JSDOM reader test against 3a alone and the native harness against 3b alone; each PR body states which before-state its screenshot shows.

findings.title: Separate camera aspect fitting from AMS web zoom
findings.evidence: fab83eef StatusPanel.cpp fit_camera_to_feed(): the camera-width part needs only the feed aspect, camera_h and the Control column's natural width; everything else (rows_base/natural loops, level/tallest solver, zoom_step, SetFitZoom) plus all of wgtAmsControlWebPanel.* and DeviceWebHost.* (+69 lines) exists only for AMS zoom. On macOS the PR already runs with zoom fixed at 1 (#if ... !defined(__WXOSX__)), so 'camera fit without zoom' is already an accepted shipped state of this PR.
findings.outcome: The uncontroversial, pure-sizer, all-OS camera fit is tied to the backend-specific (WebView2 async creation, macOS magnification exclusion, base-zoom capture, initial-height constant) and design-debatable AMS zoom. If upstream rejects the zoom, the camera fit is lost too.
findings.smallest_fix: Stack: (10a) 'Fit the live camera to its video aspect ratio' on master: fit_camera_to_feed() with zoom fixed at 1 (target = row_width - feed_width when it exceeds the natural Control width) + the three fit triggers; ~55 lines, StatusPanel only. (10b) 'Scale the AMS panel to fill the Control column' on 10a: the solver, SetFitZoom plumbing and DeviceWebHost zoom; ~165 lines. Fallback: one PR with those two commits.
findings.verification: Build 10a alone; Linux screenshot shows no pillarbox bars and a Control column with centred margins (matches current macOS behavior). 10b retains the existing 168-case model and screenshots.
findings.kind: design choice (scope); size alone not the reason

findings.title: AMS zoom up to 2x makes AMS text much larger than the native Control text beside it
findings.evidence: fab83eef StatusPanel.cpp zoom_step clamps to [1.0, 2.0] and 'if (fit < 2)' repeats the cap as a bare literal. Published after-screenshot docs/pr-evidence/2026-10-28/native-control-ams-temperature.png (blob at 91aa62a0): AMS 'Auto-refill' / 'Unload' / 'Load' render roughly 1.6-1.7x the size of the adjacent native 'Air Management' / 'Extruder' text, while the native control block above stays at 1x with wide side margins. README live measurement: AMS 1494 px wide for a 586-DIP host at 144 font DPI = zoom ~1.70.
findings.trigger: Wide main window on Linux/Windows with the web AMS view shown.
findings.outcome: Two type scales in one column; the zoomed web panel visually dominates the native controls. The user previously accepted this live, so this is a design question, not a regression.
findings.smallest_fix: Name the cap once (e.g. 'constexpr double kMaxAmsZoom') and use it in both zoom_step and the 'fit < kMaxAmsZoom' check. Recommended value 1.25 (about one Body type step); the existing 'at the cap the camera takes the rest' branch already handles the remaining width. Keep 2.0 only if the user explicitly prefers the larger AMS.
findings.verification: Re-capture the Control/AMS screenshot at the same window size; AMS label height should be within ~1.25x of native 14 px text; camera/Control bottoms still level or camera takes the remainder.

findings.title: Separate mechanical DPI unit corrections from the progress-text layout fix
findings.evidence: a1b43d73: 17 of 19 files are one mechanical pattern (drop FromDIP() around measured pixels / pass DIP values to bitmap helpers that already scale). ProgressDialog.cpp (+9/-8: viewport via ClientToWindowSize, wxALWAYS_SHOW_SB, FormatString before Fit, wxDialog::DoSetSize) and StatusPanel.cpp PrintingTaskPanel (removed SetMaxSize caps FromDIP(20)/FromDIP(13)) are visible layout behavior. The PR's only screenshot (printing-progress-user-before.png -> native-print-progress-height.png) shows the progress fix, not the unit corrections.
findings.outcome: Reviewer must separate a scan-only mechanical change from layout behavior changes; screenshot matches only a small part of the diff.
findings.smallest_fix: (5a) 'Stop double-scaling DPI-adjusted sizes' = the mechanical files (~129 changed lines); (5b) 'Let print progress text use its natural height' = ProgressDialog.cpp + the two removed caps (~19 lines) with the existing progress screenshot. Both independent on master. Optional consistency: the MultiMachine/MultiTask table headers now mix literal 16 and ICON_SINGLE_SIZE (empty-icon callers) in the same row; either leave and say why in 5a's body, or use 16 for all header buttons there.
findings.verification: Each applies to 79df7ae3; Linux build; progress probe rerun against 5b only.

findings.title: Adaptive progress dialog now always shows an empty vertical scrollbar
findings.evidence: a1b43d73 src/slic3r/GUI/Widgets/ProgressDialog.cpp:196 adds wxALWAYS_SHOW_SB to the fixed 150-DIP message viewport (adaptive mode, e.g. GLGizmoAdvancedCut.cpp:1442 'Repairing model object'). Body: 'retains its vertical scrollbar even when the message needs no scrolling'. Probe REPORT.md: short messages have max scroll 0.
findings.trigger: Any adaptive ProgressDialog with a one- or two-line message, especially Windows (classic disabled track) and GTK without overlay scrollbars.
findings.outcome: A disabled scrollbar beside mostly-empty space in a progress popup on every platform; a visible regression from stock for the common short-message case.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep wxVSCROLL only and reserve the bar width explicitly: viewport width = message width + FromDIP(5) + wxSystemSettings::GetMetric(wxSYS_VSCROLL_X, m_msg_scrolledWindow), instead of ClientToWindowSize with a forced bar. Wrap width is unchanged when the bar appears. Alternatively keep wxALWAYS_SHOW_SB if the user accepts the look.
findings.verification: Rerun the existing progress-native probe (short/long, 96/144/192 DPI) and capture a short-message dialog on GTK; Windows check when available.
findings.kind: design choice with visible cost; prior reviews chose determinism

findings.title: Assembly clearance does not need to be stacked on Assembly return
findings.evidence: Dry run: bambu-02.patch applied to 79df7ae3 copies of GLCanvas3D.cpp, AssemblyStepsUtils.hpp, AssemblyStepsUtilsImgui.cpp -> all hunks succeed (GLCanvas3D offset -2), rc=0. #1 edits GLCanvas3D.cpp:2506, #2 edits :10310/:10340 and two other files; no shared symbols.
findings.outcome: Stacking forces #1 to land first and makes #2's diff depend on another branch for no code reason.
findings.smallest_fix: Rebase #2 onto master and retarget; one line in its body: 'Independent of #1; on Linux/X11 the Return round trip is easiest to test with #1 applied.'
findings.verification: git rebase --onto master f899b75e fix/assembly-sidebar-clearance; build; same screenshot still applies.

findings.title: Field widening applies to all settings tab pages, not only the sidebar
findings.evidence: 763edb4f OG_CustomCtrl::CtrlLine::fit_field_width() runs for every OG_CustomCtrl; custom controls are created for is_tab_opt groups (OptionsGroup.cpp:129, Tab.cpp:8840, GUI_ObjectTableSettings.cpp:33). The m_max_win_width>0 exclusion never applies by default because no caller activates with wxALIGN_RIGHT (only explicit set_max_win_width). So Printer/Filament settings pages and the object table settings also widen fields up to +8 em. Title/body say 'sidebar'; screenshot shows only the sidebar Process page.
findings.trigger: Open Printer or Filament settings in a wide window.
findings.outcome: Behavior is reasonable (capped, edges aligned) but the PR understates where it applies; a reviewer may find the wider fields elsewhere unexpected.
findings.smallest_fix: Retitle 'Let single-option settings fields use spare panel width' and say once that it applies to all settings tabs; optionally add one screenshot of a wide Printer settings page showing the cap.
findings.verification: Screenshot of Printer settings at a wide width: single fields stop at default+8 em; multi-option rows unchanged.

findings.title: Print Options relayout runs on every printer status update, twice for smart nozzle-blob printers
findings.evidence: cbde5d13 PrintOptionsDialog.cpp:860 calls layout_options() at the end of update_options(); :802 update_smart_nozzle_blob_mode_desc() also calls it (line 1557). StatusPanel.cpp:3646-3647 calls update_options() on each status refresh whenever print_options_dlg exists, including while hidden after first use. Base did one Layout() there; layout_options() does a dialog Layout plus two scroll/AI-panel Layout+FitInside passes.
findings.trigger: Open Print Options once, close it, keep the printer connected.
findings.outcome: Repeated layout passes on a hidden dialog; no visible defect, just avoidable work.
findings.smallest_fix: Drop the layout_options() call inside update_smart_nozzle_blob_mode_desc() when called from update_options() (e.g. let only the two switch-event callers at :212/:219 relayout, since update_options() relayouts at its end). Optional: skip layout_options() in update_options() when !IsShown() and relayout in the existing show path.
findings.verification: Source check; Linux screenshot of the dialog after switching nozzle-blob mode still wraps correctly.

findings.title: Fix-up commits with repeated subjects and 'Address verified peer-review findings.' bodies
findings.evidence: Duplicate subjects: 0f97216d6/dc097952b, a66751278/01bc6bd9b, e20789d72/a1b43d73c, 191c22e46/8a700863e, 6ab2240a5/763edb4f6, 0688d34a8/e51f9b9c4. #6's 8a700863e adds TextInput/ComboBox font plumbing in 5 files that cbde5d139 removes again. #10 has 'Clarify the AMS initial-height constant reference' as its own commit. The evidence README already says to squash before upstream.
findings.outcome: History shows code added then removed and meaningless fix-up messages; harder to follow.
findings.smallest_fix: Squash each PR to one commit (or the two logical commits proposed in DS-R1-01/02/04 if kept in one PR), with a plain-language subject matching the PR title and no review-process text.
findings.verification: git log master..branch shows 1-2 commits per PR; git diff of tip unchanged except for any accepted findings.
findings.kind: known limit (README) restated because it is the user's stated goal

findings.title: wx master moved; its new WebView2 change matters for PR10's Windows check
findings.evidence: e2fa9bda..abb54269 adds 60b64f83b2 'disable wxWebViewEdge text scale on windows' (src/msw/webview_edge.cpp only: put_ShouldDetectMonitorScaleChanges(FALSE), put_RasterizationScale(GetDPIScaleFactor())). No overlap with wx#1 (src/gtk/control.cpp) or wx#2 (include/wx/window.h, interface/wx/window.h, src/gtk/window.cpp). PR10 sizes the WebView2 host from CSS px and sets ZoomFactor on the same control.
findings.trigger: Windows with text scaling >100%, AMS web view zoomed.
findings.outcome: PR10's Windows behavior depends on which wx it builds with; checks done against older wx would not represent current master.
findings.smallest_fix: Rebase both wx drafts onto abb54269 (no conflicts expected). In PR10's body, name wx abb54269 or later as the Windows baseline to verify.
findings.verification: Text-level apply of wx-01/wx-02 to abb54269; future Windows run of PR10 with that wx.

findings.title: Non-creating auxiliary path accessor copies the path format by hand
findings.evidence: 0826d59e src/libslic3r/Model.cpp:1099-1103 returns backup_path + "//Auxiliaries" to mirror get_auxiliary_file_temp_path() = get_backup_path("/Auxiliaries") = get_backup_path() + "/" + "/Auxiliaries" (Model.cpp:1187). ProjectPanel::matches_project() compares the two strings to decide whether to publish.
findings.trigger: Someone later changes the sub-path string or separator in one accessor only.
findings.outcome: matches_project() silently returns false and Project metadata is never shown; no compile error.
findings.smallest_fix: Define the sub-path once (e.g. a file-local 'static const char* AUXILIARIES_SUBDIR = "/Auxiliaries"') and build both strings from it with the same '/' join, or at minimum cross-reference the two functions in comments.
findings.verification: Source check; existing identity harness still passes.

findings.title: wxGetApp().url_encode -> Http::url_encode swap is unneeded churn
findings.evidence: Base GUI_App.cpp:8066 'std::string GUI_App::url_encode(std::string value) { return Http::url_encode(value); }' is a stateless wrapper. 0826d59e swaps it in on_reload (UI thread) and Reload (worker), adding #include "slic3r/Utils/Http.hpp" to Project.cpp.
findings.outcome: Extra changed lines with no behavior difference.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep the existing wxGetApp().url_encode calls (safe from a worker: static accessor + stateless curl escape) and drop the include; or keep the swap and say why in the commit message.

defended_complexity: bambu#3 ReloadState (mutex + generation + alive) with app-level CallAfter: needed because workers must not touch a destroyed panel and the check-then-post must not race panel/app teardown; panel->CallAfter from a worker would itself race destruction.

bambu#6 LB_AUTO_WRAP labels with min width 0 and a guarded two-pass layout_options(): LB_AUTO_WRAP is an existing idiom (62 base uses); two passes cover rewrap height change and scrollbar appearance. Body_12 on the five readonly selectors matches their Body_12 'Pausing Sensitivity:' labels (base ComboBox default is Body_14).
bambu#7 update on EVT_SIZE, activate() and msw_rescale(): each covers a real entry point; rescale order verified (fields rescale before custom_ctrl->msw_rescale()).

bambu#8 absolutely positioned wiki icon: reproduces the printer card's edit-icon corner (4 DIP down, 6+8=14 DIP in) without consuming the bed card's vertically centred layout; the filament gap constant keeps the width calculation and sizer in agreement.

bambu#9 wxEVT_TEXT relayout: required because StatusPanel.cpp:2549-2561 calls GetTextCtrl()->SetValue() directly, bypassing SetTagTemp(); clicking the slash/target/unit area to focus keeps the hit target after the entry shrank.
bambu#10 per-item natural-width loop: subtracting the zoomed AMS width from CalcMin() would lose a wider header row, as the code comment says.

app: #6 Print Options wrap (unchanged scope, squash)
app: #8 Sidebar cards and purge alignment (unchanged)
app: #10b AMS fit zoom (~165, stacked on #10a)
wx: #1 GTK label font measurement (rebase to abb54269)
wx: #2 GTK3 DIP font resolution (rebase to abb54269; merge gate unchanged)
